scope: Actual durable retry eligibility and same-job identity across rate limiting, recovery, provider unavailability and OAuth token rejection; no clock or queue timing mutation
jobs_sql: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status',status,'attempt_count',attempt_count,'max_attempts',max_attempts,'result',result,'last_error_code',last_error_code,'last_error_summary',last_error_summary,'lease_owner_present',lease_owner IS NOT NULL,'lease_expires_present',lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL,'started',started_at IS NOT NULL,'completed',completed_at IS NOT NULL,'retry_delay_within_backoff_bounds',CASE WHEN status='retry' THEN extract(epoch FROM available_at-updated_at) BETWEEN (15*power(2,attempt_count-1)-0.1) AND (20*power(2,attempt_count-1)+0.1) ELSE NULL END,'retry_scheduled',CASE WHEN status='retry' THEN available_at>updated_at ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY created_at,id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_jobs
